messages:
maya: Heads-up — private rollout to acme-vpc started but canary split never landed on their nodes. Traffic stayed 100% on stable. Not seeing any control-plane acks in their region.
liam: ugh. is this the air-gapped site where we only push diffs via the offline bundle? :thinking_face:
maya: yes. we pushed the bundle at 09:12 UTC. deploy-bot reported success, but the agent heartbeat didn't show the config apply. logs from customer side show the agent pulled the bundle but failed with a 504 apply timeout.
raj: is this the old behavior where offline bundles need a follow-up reconcile due to long GC pauses on their proxy? iirc we had a race where snapshot metadata is pruned before the agent copies the manifest.
sre-jen: can you paste the deploy-bot payload? we should check the rollout metadata, especially the split tokens and the snapshot id.
deploy-bot: [automation] deploy event: rollout_id=rb-20260320-1223, target=acme-vpc, mode=private, canary_split=10/90, bundle=rb-bundle-20260320-09:12, status=applied_to_controlplane
maya: here's the minimal excerpt we got from deploy-bot + agent logs:
```
deploy-bot: status=applied_to_controlplane, snapshot=sha256:abcd1234
agent: pulled bundle rb-bundle-20260320-09:12
agent: apply start
agent: apply error: timeout waiting for local-store-commit
```
liam: that timeout is the key. our control plane gives an "applied" ack after it writes the snapshot into the control-store and broadcasts the change. Agent needs to ACK the snapshot before we mark nodes as done.
raj: for private/VPC we currently assume eventually-consistent apply and rely on heartbeats for reconciliation. But heartbeats are infrequent in some air-gapped installs (30s+) so the console thinks rollout is live when agents haven't finished.
maya: consequence: routing policy updated in the distributed router to send 10% to canary variant, but the canary wasn't actually installed -> requests routed to canary proxy which responded with 404 fallbacks and then routed back to stable, causing higher latency and errors for that 10%.
sre-jen: not great. we should add a guard: don't change routing for private until a quorum of target nodes return an "applied" ack for the rollout snapshot. fallback behavior should be an immediate local fallback (no remote split) rather than sending to a half-installed canary.
liam: agreed. idea: introduce a two-phase commit for private rollouts: phase 1 publish snapshot but keep router pinned to stable; phase 2 once N% nodes ACK, flip the router. That avoids split holes.
raj: implementation detail: nodes behind NAT/airgap may never reach 100% ack within SLA. we need configurable grace windows and a manual override in Console.
maya: Console UX item: show precise per-node status for rollout with a small map + ETA estimate and 'stall reason' e.g., "apply-timeout", "missing-deps". Right now Console just shows "in progress" which is misleading.
console-bot: [note] new UX mock saved: /ux/rollouts/private-apply-status-v2.jpg
liam: also telemetry: we currently emit rollout_event but not rollout_applied_latency. We should add metrics:
- rollout_publish_ts
- node_ack_ts (per node)
- rollout_committed_ts
and expose histogram rollout_applied_latency(bucket: seconds)
raj: + alert when commit latency > X for private rollouts targeting >Y nodes. Prefer warn at 60s, critical at 5m for enterprise SLAs.
sre-jen: for immediate mitigation: disable traffic flipping by default for private until N nodes ack or timeout. Add a CLI flag `--force-unsafe-flip` for SEs during manual cutovers.
maya: can we add a conservative fallback routing policy: when routing table references a model variant that is not confirmed on a node, the node should serve stable locally rather than forwarding into a partially-install path. That reduces error churn.
liam: yes, router already understands local variant availability; we'll expose a "require-local-confirmation" flag in the rollout spec. default true for private, false for hosted.
maya: test plan: reproduce with small cluster, simulate apply-timeout and ensure router doesn't flip and Console shows pending ack counts. add e2e test that asserts no 404s produced during partial installs.
raj: note for docs: explain the propagation semantics for private rollouts, include sequencing diagrams and failure modes. Also list recommended grace windows by deployment size.
sre-jen: I'll draft dashboard panels tonight: per-rollout progress, node ack histogram, stalled nodes table, and a single-panel SLO for "rollout success rate" by target size.
maya: thanks team. i'm going to open the RFC and a small prod-safe patch set for the two-phase commit + telemetry. tagging @liam @raj for review. :thumbsup:
liam: on it.
raj: will review tomorrow.
deploy-bot: [automation] RFC created: rfc/priv-rollout-two-phase-2026-03-20
console-bot: [automation] QA job queued: qa/rollout-e2e-private-2026-03-20"
